zh.title: 面向消除类游戏广告素材的可复用生产系统
zh.subtitle: 系统设计、实现与生产实践技术报告
zh.abstract: 消除类休闲游戏广告需要持续制作牌面、材质、堆叠、特效和操作节奏的变体。团队对成片进行生成式编辑时，局部替换的跨帧保持与玩法合理性增加了筛选和返工；与此同时，专业源工程中已有的对象、动画、材质及合成关系尚未得到充分复用。本报告介绍 Melo Game Creative Studio（melo-gcs）及其与外部 Agent、元素库和专业软件构成的可复用生产系统。存量源工程可直接改造，也可提取适用元素，供后续多模态召回与拼装；缺少源工程时，Agent 可根据参考视频调用 melo-gcs CLI 建立可编辑项目。项目分离玩法记录、演出时间与元素关联，支持后续外观、布局、动作和节奏修改。Chromium GPU 渲染承担浏览器出片，并支持无头运行；浏览器表现不能满足设计要求时，再转入AE／Blender 原生工程精修。报告通过源工程布局改造、采样帧保存重载检查及原创素材变体三个案例说明设计与项目复用。经作者确认的生产记录包括 18 组任务、每组 4 条：在报告的两小时生产阶段内导出 72 条视频，其中 50 条（69.4%）通过内部综合验收并已投放；每条输出的模型 Token 费用低于 1 美元，不含其他制作成本。本报告结合系统实现、制作案例和生产观察，介绍了以存量设计复用、领域编排和浏览器渲染支持广告变体制作的一条实际路径。
zh.keywords: 消除类游戏广告；设计源工程复用；melo-gcs；外部 Agent；玩法编排；无头渲染；Chromium

en.title: A Reusable Production System for Casual Puzzle Game Ad Creatives
en.subtitle: Design, Implementation, and Production Practice
en.abstract: Casual puzzle-game advertisements require recurring changes to tile faces, materials, stacks, effects, and interaction pacing. In the team’s generative editing workflow, preserving local edits across frames and maintaining plausible gameplay required repeated selection and rework. Meanwhile, professional source projects retained underused objects, animations, materials, and compositing relationships. This technical report presents Melo Game Creative Studio (melo-gcs) and a reusable production system integrating external agents, an element library, and professional authoring tools. Existing source projects can be edited directly or provide reusable elements for multimodal retrieval and assembly. When no source project is available, an agent can build an editable project from a reference video through the melo-gcs CLI. Projects separate gameplay recordings, presentation timing, and element references to support subsequent appearance, layout, action, and pacing edits. Chromium GPU rendering supports browser-based and headless video production; native After Effects or Blender refinement is used when browser output does not meet design requirements. Three cases illustrate source-project layout editing, save-and-reload checks at sampled frames, and variants made from original assets. Author-confirmed production records describe 18 groups of four variants: 72 videos were exported during a reported two-hour production stage, and 50 (69.4%) passed internal review and were deployed. Recorded model token charges were below US$1 per produced video, excluding other production costs. The report brings together implementation, cases, and production observations to document a practical route to advertisement variants through reuse of existing designs, domain-specific authoring, and browser rendering.
en.keywords: casual puzzle-game advertising; source-project reuse; melo-gcs; external agents; gameplay authoring; headless rendering; Chromium

zh: 系统总体架构。源工程可直接改造，或提取元素供多模态召回与拼装。melo-gcs 通过 Chromium GPU 无头渲染，结果满足设计要求时直接交付，否则由专用导入 Skill 转入 AE／Blender 精修。图中仅标出专业导入的作用与位置。
内容接入与持续制作。源工程可直接修改或整理为元素，参考视频则用于建立 melo-gcs 项目。项目变体经玩法与资源检查、Chromium GPU 渲染、媒体检查和设计审阅后交付。技术问题返回相应 melo-gcs 环节，浏览器表现无法满足设计要求时再转入 DCC。
基于可编辑 AEP 的参考布局重排。（a）原 AE 工程的渲染画面；（b）目标堆叠参考；（c）调整牌块位置、层级与遮挡后的结果。前后沿用原工程的界面框架、牌体表现和手势素材，参考图仅提供布局要求。
匿名项目 A001 的保存重载与连续编辑。（a）保存前的项目输出；（b）读取已保存项目文件后的输出；（c）基于重载项目修改堆叠后的输出。三栏均为第 58 帧（30 fps，约 1.93 秒）；像素一致性比较针对（a）与（b），抽检帧为第 0、58、434 帧。
原创素材的导入、保存与变体生成。（a）自制透明图案和背景；（b）经公共 CLI 导入、绑定并保存重载后渲染的青绿版本；（c）基于已保存项目修改配色、背景和标题颜色后的暖珊瑚版本。两版本保持 36 张牌、棋盘布局、玩法配置与 Take 记录一致。
en: Overall system architecture. Source projects can be edited directly or supply elements for multimodal retrieval and composition. melo-gcs performs headless rendering with Chromium and the GPU. Outputs meeting design requirements are delivered directly; otherwise, a dedicated import Skill transfers the project to After Effects or Blender for refinement. The figure shows only the role and position of professional import.

Content intake and continued production. Source projects may be edited directly or organised into elements; reference videos are used to build melo-gcs projects. Variants pass through gameplay and resource checks, Chromium GPU rendering, media checks, and design review. Technical issues return to the relevant melo-gcs step. DCC refinement is used when the browser’s visual result does not meet design requirements.

Reference-guided layout rearrangement in an editable AEP. (a) A rendering of the original After Effects project. (b) The target stack reference. (c) The result after changing tile positions, layer order, and occlusion. The original interface framework, tile-body appearance, and gesture assets are retained; the reference supplies layout requirements only.

Save-and-reload and continued editing for anonymised project A001. (a) Output before saving. (b) Output after reloading the saved project file. (c) Output after editing the stack in the reloaded project. All panels show frame 58 (30 fps, approximately 1.93 s). Pixel-consistency checks compare (a) and (b) at frames 0, 58, and 434.

Import, saving, and variation with original assets. (a) Self-created transparent motifs and backgrounds. (b) A teal version rendered after CLI import, binding, saving, and reloading. (c) A warm-coral version made by changing motif colours, the background, and title colour in the saved project. Both versions retain the same 36 tiles, board layout, gameplay configuration, and Take.
